title: Fragment 01
body: A chronicle of Japan was broken into pieces and scattered along a family’s route. It can only be repaired by looking — not by remaining on a phone.

title: Fragment 02
body: The country named itself after the sun. The red disc is not dusk. It is origin.

title: Fragment 03
body: Edo was wet ground. Tokyo learned to stack. The second city is under the first.

title: Fragment 04
body: Inari’s post arrives by fox. The mountain of gates is not an emperor’s work. It is a pile of private hopes.

title: Fragment 05
body: Some pages are not adventures. They are records. Hiroshima is one of those pages.
